title: UNDERTONE: subharmonic machine
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: UNDERTONE, a subharmonic SRC machine inspired by how the Moog Subharmonicon builds sound and by the Labyrinth's wavefolder: two oscillators, each with two subharmonics (its pitch divided by 1-16), saw to square, osc 2 an interval away in free, equal or just tuning, a wavefolder and a slow analog drift. Page 2's VIEW shows the six tones on a pitch ladder, or the waveform. Machine 35. Needs machine-pages 1.5 or newer and core 4.4. Its sequencers (SUBSEQ) are now in FREQSEQ.
